title: Waist heart: chin tap, flex, finger wag, then a heart at your waist
summary: A nine-second clip: you tap your chin, flex, wag two fingers, then rest a curved hand on your waist so it makes a heart.
why: Jump on the Trend's Waist Heart page (updated November 12, 2026) marks it as new: the first posts went up on Instagram and TikTok between November 3 and 6, and one TikTok version had about 1.5 million views by November 12. The page calls it a follow-up to the bicep heart, which already has its own pack here; this one ends with a heart at the waist instead.
steps: Pick a clear, full-length or waist-up photo of yourself, standing, with both arms visible.
Upload it to an image-to-video tool and paste the main prompt. Ask for a vertical clip, about 9 seconds.
Check the last pose: your curved hand and your waist should clearly form a heart. If it looks like a plain hand on the hip, run it again.
Post it with a short, warm caption, like "Sending love from the waist up."

prompts.label: Main prompt: the four-move waist heart
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. They stand in a bright, tidy room, facing a phone camera on a stand. One smooth shot, 9 seconds, vertical. Move 1: they tap their chin with one finger, as if thinking. Move 2: they flex one arm and look at it, proud. Move 3: they wag two fingers at the camera, playful. Move 4: they place one hand on their waist with the fingers curved, so the hand and the side of the waist form a clear heart shape. They hold it, smile and sway gently. Natural light, real skin, simple clothes. Keep their face, hair and outfit the same as the photo.

prompts.label: Variation: cosy winter version
prompts.text: Use the person in this photo. They stand in a warm living room with a lit fireplace and a few fairy lights. They wear a chunky knit sweater. One shot, 9 seconds, vertical. They tap their chin, flex one arm, wag two fingers at the camera, then rest one curved hand on their waist so it makes a heart shape. They smile and sway. Soft, warm light, cosy feel. Keep their face and hair the same as the photo.

prompts.label: Variation: small business thank-you
prompts.text: Make a 9-second vertical video for a small shop or studio. A friendly owner in a plain apron, no logos, stands in front of a shelf of their products. They tap their chin, flex one arm, wag two fingers at the camera, then rest one curved hand on their waist so it makes a heart shape. They smile warmly. Bright, clean light, one smooth shot. Leave the top third clear so I can add text like "Thank you for shopping small this year".

tips: The heart is the payoff. Say "the hand and the waist form a clear heart shape" in your prompt so the tool doesn't skip it.
A photo with your arms away from your body gives the tool more room to get the hand right.
If the moves blur together, add "each move is clear and separate, about two seconds each".
Pair it with your bicep heart clip as a two-part post.
